title: Platform configuration
html:
Goal: as admin, walk through the pages of the Configuration group that matter to the flywheel, and learn what the organization structure, network, storage, cost, models, sign-in and updates each govern and at which layer. Then bind the preset network profile workshop-private and storage workshop-files to 零售客服 (Retail service) by hand, and confirm that 旅行客服 (Travel service) cannot see it.

Prerequisites

  • You finished Teams and Roles: the department 客服中心 (Customer Care) and the projects 零售客服 and 旅行客服 exist, and the four accounts are members of 零售客服.
  • The holder of the main console signs in as admin. The rest of the team watches; only section 9 needs developer to sign in.

1. One map (3 min)

Configuration lives in three layers. A lower layer inherits from the one above it and can only narrow it, never widen it:

Layer Where What it governs
Platform Configuration → Models / Single sign-on / Administrators / System update The models the platform itself calls, how people sign in, who is an admin, the console version
Workspace (one AWS account + Region) Configuration → Workspaces / Network profiles / Storage / Cost tags The VPCs agents may run in, the file systems they may mount, the cost tags written on resources
Project Configuration → Projects → a project's Settings tab Which network profiles and storage the project may use, quotas and the monthly budget, custom cost tags, member visibility

The department → project → member line you built in the previous chapter decides who can see and act. The workspace's network profiles and storage decide where agents run. The two meet at the project: an admin allows a network profile and a storage entry for a project, and only then can that project's members choose them when they create an agent.

2. Network profiles: bind the private network to 零售客服 (admin, 8 min)

Open Configuration → Network profiles (/v3/network). The organizer's deployment script already registered the profile workshop-private: the two private subnets of this environment's VPC (use1-az1, use1-az2) plus the agent security group, with Preflight passed.

  1. In the Allowed profiles per project panel, choose 零售客服 (retail-service) under Project.
  2. Tick Allowed on the workshop-private row, then pick the default radio button on the same row.
  3. Click Save allowed set. The toast reads "Allowed profiles of retail-service saved".

After saving, the Used by column of workshop-private reads 2 project(s) · 0 agent(s) with a shared chip: both Default and 零售客服 allow it. The default profile is preselected in 零售客服's new-agent wizard, so the agent you build in the flywheel runs in the private subnets and reaches the internet through the NAT gateway.

The Network rules of this workspace panel below has two switches. Leave both as they are for this workshop:

  • Agents may run on the public network (PUBLIC): ticked. Turned off, every agent must choose a network profile (recommended for production), but only the platform enforces it.
  • This workspace enforces the approved subnets and security groups at the IAM layer: unticked. The panel lists the approved subnets and security groups, the actions covered, and a Policy document you can apply as an SCP or an inline policy. It also names the two gaps of the IAM layer: the managed-harness create calls carry no network condition keys, and IAM cannot refuse PUBLIC.

A network profile only records which VPC may be used; it creates no network resource. The organizer's CloudFormation stack built the VPC, subnets, security groups and NAT gateway. To run the workshop in an existing VPC, see the appendix Organizer deployment.

3. Storage: bind S3 Files to 零售客服 (admin, 5 min)

Open Configuration → Storage (/v3/storage). The deployment script registered workshop-files: kind S3 Files, mount targets in use1-az1 and use1-az2, Max mode · data read-write · scratch, and Check passed.

  1. In the Project access panel, choose 零售客服 as the project.
  2. Tick Allowed on workshop-files and click Save access. The toast reads "Saved storage access for retail-service".

Only now can 零售客服's agents mount it in the wizard's Storage step. A mount needs the agent to run on a network profile in the same VPC, so the binding in section 2 comes first.

4. Project settings: the boundaries of 零售客服 (admin, 5 min)

Open Configuration → Projects → 零售客服 → Settings and read it top to bottom. Change nothing in this chapter:

Card Contents In this workshop
General Name, department, description The values from the previous chapter
Access Resource visibility, Separate duties strictly (sod_strict) Shared (the flywheel hands one agent between four accounts, so they must see each other's resources); sod_strict unticked
Quotas and monthly budget Agents, Enabled API keys, Concurrent evaluation runs, Monthly budget (USD), /v1 calls per minute (all keys); a platform administrator sets this table, and an empty field means no limit; the monthly budget can also be set by an administrator of the project's department under Spend & alerts → Department budgets. An alert fires at 80% of the budget; once the project's spend this month reaches Monthly budget (USD), chat, invokes, deploys, evaluation runs, experiments, Skill Lab and other billable work are refused (409 project.budget_exhausted) until the budget resets on the 1st (UTC) or is raised; work already running is not stopped. When the department allows overrun, the project can switch it on too, which moves the lines to an alert at 105% and refusal at 110% All unset (no limit); this workshop sets no budget
Cost tags The five launchpad:* keys the platform writes on project resources, up to 10 custom tags; budgets read the Estimate or the Billed cost basis No custom tag
Runtime isolation Shared (data visibility only) or Isolated (each agent's role carries the project's permission boundary and uses the project's own memory, gateway credentials and repository) Shared
Integration / Lifecycle Export the ARNs and a merged policy for every invocable agent; archive, export a data package, request deletion No action

With Separate duties strictly ticked, one person cannot hold a pair of conflicting project roles (for example writing criteria and signing them): saving the member is refused. Unticked, the members table only shows the ⚠ duty-merge hint. Either way, the server checks every signature by account.

5. Cost tags (admin, 5 min)

Open Configuration → Cost tags (/v3/cost-tags). The platform writes five tags on every resource it creates, with launchpad:project as the primary dimension:

Key Value
launchpad:project Project id (shared for workspace-shared resources)
launchpad:workspace Workspace id
launchpad:agent-id Agent id (agent-level resources)
launchpad:managed-by launchpad
launchpad:department Department id

The progress line at the top shows the four steps from "tagged" to "billed by project": Tagged (on create and update) → Activated (activated as a cost allocation tag in Billing) → Settling (about 24 h in Billing) → Billed by project (the billing view on Costs). The card How a project's billed cost is built splits a project's bill into its own resources, a usage-weighted share of the shared infrastructure, and untagged cost that is listed separately and never shared out. Backfill existing resources tags the resources created before the tag set existed.

Cost Explorer groups by a tag only the cost incurred after the tag is activated. A two-day workshop is too short to see billed cost per project, so the flywheel chapters use the Estimate basis (model tokens × the price table, available within minutes).

Activate 5 keys at the top right and Run back-fill under Backfill existing resources both change the whole AWS account (its Billing settings, the tags on every resource). Do not click them during the workshop; that is the organizer's decision.

6. Models (admin, 3 min)

Configuration → Models (/v3/models) lists every model role the platform calls or preselects: platform model, evaluator judge, judge fallback, the architect assistant, the default for new agents, the simulated user, the Skill Lab judge and target models, and more. Each row shows the current value and its source (default, environment variable or console override), and you can Test a model before you Save it. A value saved here takes effect at once and wins over the environment variable written at deployment. Changing the Evaluator judge changes evaluation scores, so runs before and after the change are no longer comparable; leave it alone during the workshop.

7. Single sign-on, administrators and system update (admin, 3 min)

  • Single sign-on (/v3/sso): SAML 2.0 (IAM Identity Center, Microsoft Entra ID, any SAML 2.0 provider) and OpenID Connect (Keycloak, Authentik, generic OIDC). The first sign-in creates the account, and roles and projects follow the IdP groups. A new provider starts disabled, and local accounts keep working until you enable it. This workshop uses local accounts only; the appendix covers IAM Identity Center.
  • Administrators (/v3/admins): platform admins hold every permission and can enter every project; at least one admin must be able to sign in. With the Two-person rule for organization admins on, a project membership change made by an organization admin takes effect only after another organization admin or the project's owner confirms it.
  • System update (/v3/system-update): the current version, the latest console-v3 commit and the updater state. Prepare update stages a new version to apply at a time you pick, and a failed update can be rolled back. The short sha at the bottom left of the rail is the current version. Do not update during the workshop.
  • Fleet (/v3/fleet): the health, governance findings and shared templates of every workspace at once. This environment has a single workspace, Default.

8. Leave 旅行客服 empty (admin, 2 min)

Open Configuration → Projects → 旅行客服. Its Members tab is empty, and no network profile or storage is allowed for it. It stands for another team's project in the same department; the workshop does nothing in it.

9. Check project isolation (developer, 2 min)

Sign in as developer and open the Project switcher in the top bar: it lists only Default and 零售客服, not 旅行客服. Opening /v3/projects?id=travel-service directly fails too. For a non-member the server answers "not found" rather than "forbidden", so it does not even reveal that the other project exists.

Chapter checklist

  • Under Network profiles → Allowed profiles per project, 零售客服 allows workshop-private as its default, and the list shows Used by 2 project(s) · 0 agent(s)
  • Under Storage → Project access, 零售客服 allows workshop-files
  • 零售客服's Settings tab shows resource visibility Shared and runtime isolation Shared
  • You can name the four steps from "Tagged" to "Billed by project" and explain why the workshop uses the Estimate basis
  • 旅行客服 has no members, network or storage, and developer's project switcher does not list it

FAQ

Symptom Cause Fix
零售客服 is missing from the Project dropdown The project from the previous chapter was not created, or was archived Go back to Teams and Roles section 3.2
The network profiles list is empty The deployment script did not register the profile (it does not when the stack is deployed into an existing VPC) Click New profile, enter the stack outputs AgentVpcId, AgentSubnetIds and AgentSecurityGroupId, then click Check
The storage list is empty, or Check fails Same as above, or the mount targets are still being created Click Register storage and enter the stack output FilesAccessPointArn; check again after a few minutes
The cost tags page shows AccessDeniedException ... ce:ListCostAllocationTags The console instance role has no Cost Explorer permissions The organizer deploys with the latest template, as in the appendix Organizer deployment; no other workshop step is affected
workshop-private cannot be chosen in the new-agent wizard The project in the top bar is not 零售客服, or section 2 was not saved Switch to 零售客服, then save the allowed set again
